gerard_established_by: Title: 'Six Quartetti ... en deux livraisons. Op. 58. 1re partie'. Op. 58 is G242-247; which three quartets this part holds is NOT established -- only 15 images, so it may be a single part-book.
rism_related_established_by: This copy is not in RISM -- it was found on a library portal. These are RISM's records for the same print of the same works (GerB 242, 243, 244, 245, 246, 247), matched on the Gérard set. They describe the edition, not this copy.
